english.title: Use / cause / permit vehicle with dangerous load - Liverpool Airport
english.standardoffencewording:
On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..), on part of Liverpool John Lennon Airport to which the road traffic enactments did not apply, namely **(..SPECIFY THE LOCATION..),

(A)_[used a vehicle,]_
(B)_[caused a vehicle to be used,]_
(C)_[permitted a vehicle to be used,]_

namely **(..SPECIFY VEHICLE MAKE AND INDEX NUMBER..), when the load carried by it, namely **(..SPECIFY LOAD..), was not at all times secured and in such position that neither danger nor nuisance was caused, or was likely to be caused, to a person or property by reason of the load, or any part of it falling or being blown from the vehicle or by reason of any other movement of the load or a part of it in relation to the vehicle
english.legislation: Contrary to byelaws 2(1)(b) and 5(7)(b) of the Liverpool John Lennon Airport Byelaws 2022.
